description: Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes are included.

d.request: Only tracks with `Track.Bytes` strictly greater than 10,323,804 are included; for each MediaType name, average `Bytes / Milliseconds` across those tracks, then return the unweighted mean of those per-media-type averages, unrounded.
d.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS result FROM (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.Name) AS per_media_type;

b.request: For tracks with `Bytes` strictly greater than 10,323,804, compute each media type's mean of per-track `Bytes / Milliseconds` (grouped by `MediaType.Name`), then return the unweighted mean of those per-media-type averages, unrounded.
b.sql: WITH per_media AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS result FROM per_media;
b.raw: For tracks with `Bytes` strictly greater than 10,323,804, compute each media type's mean of per-track `Bytes / Milliseconds` (grouped by `MediaType.Name`), then return the unweighted mean of those per-media-type averages, unrounded.

c.request: Considering only tracks that pass a file-size (`Track.Bytes`) cutoff of 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded. Only tracks whose file size is strictly greater than 10,323,804 bytes are included.
c.sql: WITH per_type AS (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 AND t.Milliseconds > 0 GROUP BY mt.Name) SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS result FROM per_type;

a.request: Considering only tracks whose file size (`Track.Bytes`) is more than 10,323,804 bytes, work out for each media type (by name) the average bytes per millisecond (`Bytes` ÷ `Milliseconds`) of its tracks. What is the simple average of these per-media-type averages? Return just that single value, unrounded.
a.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bytes_per_ms) AS result FROM (SELECT mt.Name AS media_type, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bytes_per_ms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.Name) AS per_media_type;
